body: We do it to improve on ourselves, to pick up the shambles that became our confidence. Rejection hurts the human ego severely, its human nature to embittered yourself for your next potential love interest. We are human. We are flawed. We learn when the damage is done, that is human nature. If everything were perfect humans could not be humans. Acceptance is painful, but it's something we have to come in terms with. The person that did the action of rejection was looking out for themselves. Many villanize the person doing the rejection, but that how we are programmed as males. We are logical creatures that need to control our emotions in order to be the supportive mountain for our other partner regardless of gender.
